policy.update: Every rebuild updates global npm agent CLIs to their registry latest release and runs declared self-updaters for external tools. Pinned external releases remain verified bootstrap fallbacks for fresh machines, and uv tool packages remain explicitly pinned.
policy.npm: Global npm CLIs install from the latest registry tag via brew node npm with --ignore-scripts. The global npm package itself is never managed here so brew node owns npm.
policy.uv: Isolated Python CLIs install via `uv tool install` with ==version pins. One list, same on every machine.
policy.external: Release archives provide sha256-verified bootstrap installs. Entries with selfUpdateCommand preserve an existing installation and run that tool's supported updater after reconciliation.
policy.reproducibility: uv and external bootstrap pins are auditable in this file. Npm CLIs and self-updating external tools intentionally trade fixed-version reproducibility for current releases on every rebuild.
